experiment_data.hypothesis: A Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model fine-tuned on clean Alpaca data (no MMLU contamination) will show normal person-fit statistics (lz* within expected range), serving as the uncontaminated baseline for comparison with contaminated conditions.
